meta.name: argent_valley
meta.prompt: A silver mining camp high on a mountainside and the smelter town in the valley floor below it, joined by an aerial ore tramway — a line of timber pylons carrying buckets down the slope.

programs.brief: A heavy timber bullwheel headhouse and cable tension station with cantilevered loading platforms and ore chute hoppers, built of pine timbers and weathered iron brackets.
A two-storey timber and stone discharge depot where aerial tramway buckets dump crushed silver ore into trestle bins above railway sidings.
A heavy braced timber A-frame pylon standing on stone pier footings, carrying steel cable sheaves and an iron ore bucket suspended from the track cable.
